grammar.summary: 本课学习表方式的介词 by 与 be frightened 感受结构。

points.title: by + 交通工具
points.explanation: by air/plane = 乘飞机，by 后接零冠词；take a plane 则有冠词。固定搭配需记忆。

examples.en: We used to fly to Paris.
examples.cn: 我们过去常乘飞机去巴黎。

points.title: -ed 表感受/-ing 表属性（复现）
points.explanation: I was frightened / The flight was frightening. 感受与属性形容词的分工复现。

examples.en: We were worried about the weather.
